issues.description: Import order within the third-party group is not alphabetical: 'from conan.tools.files import ...' appears before 'from conan.tools.cmake import ...'. PEP 8 and the code style example (rule 16) imply alphabetical ordering within groups (cmake < files).
issues.fix_suggestion: Reorder imports so 'from conan.tools.cmake import ...' comes before 'from conan.tools.files import ...' to match alphabetical convention.

issues.description: The version-level manifest.yaml is missing the 'name' field that the code style spec (rule 14) shows as required ('name: zlib'). The directory structure implies the name, but the field is absent from the file.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding 'name: libsamplerate' at the top of the manifest for consistency with the code style spec, unless the project's version-level manifest format intentionally omits it.

issues.description: The manifest uses a nested 'build: system: cmake' structure instead of the flat 'build_system: cmake' field shown in the code style spec (rule 14).
issues.fix_suggestion: If the version-level manifest format allows nesting, this is acceptable. Otherwise, consider using 'build_system: cmake' as a flat field to match the spec.

issues.description: The 'requirements()' method contains only 'pass'. While not a template placeholder (no TODO/FIXME comment), an empty requirements() method can be omitted entirely since Conan does not require it when there are no dependencies.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider removing the empty 'def requirements(self): pass' method for cleaner code, as the default behavior is identical.
